title: Follow up sent quotes
trigger: A quote sent from Xero has had no reply for 7 days

frequency.detail: 7 days after the quote is sent

inputs.item: Quote number, customer and total for each quote with no reply after 7 days

outputs.destination: Sent from the accounts inbox to the customer

steps.action: List quotes sent 7 or more days ago that have no reply
Draft a follow-up email for each quote
Review each draft and send it

decisionPoints.condition: The quote is commercial and over $10,000
decisionPoints.action: Don't draft an email; flag it to Dana to ring the customer

qualityChecks: Every quote with no reply after 7 days has either a sent follow-up email or a flag to Dana

escalation.when: A customer asks for a discount or a change to the quoted price
A customer asks about warranties or liability
